name: [UPD4] Steal a Character
desc:
💸 Earn money from Characters!

😈 Steal a Character!

🧙‍♂️Welcome to Steal a Character🧙‍♂️

[How To Play]
• Wait for your favourite character to appear from the portal!
• Walk up to your favourite character and buy them!
• Look around other players' character collections!
• Steal their characters!
